fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete 14ft aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer, which we can detail.
findings: Dull, chalky gray oxidation on the bare aluminum hull sides, port and starboard
Grime and staining along the lower hull near the keel on the port side
Loose clutter on the front platform: tangled rope, cords and a fishing net
Dirt and debris on the unfinished wood platform boards at the bow
Red carpet on the floor and bench tops looks dusty and matted
Dirt and scuffing on the interior aluminum walls and bench faces
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Northwoods 14ft with the Johnson. The aluminum hull sides look a bit dull and chalky in the photos, and the red carpet and bow platform could use a cleanup. We do mobile pre-sale details, including hull cleaning and polishing plus carpet and interior cleaning, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
